about: The offertorium of the formulary “Fifth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Bless the Lord our God, O ye nations, and hearken to the voice of His praise. He hath set my soul in life and hath not suffered my feet to be moved. Blessed be the Lord, Who hath not turned away my prayer nor His mercy from me, alleluia.
